rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Taiga MCP Server provides direct access to Taiga project management platform through natural language interactions, enabling project workflow automation including user story creation, task management, project member coordination, and status tracking. Built with Python using httpx for API communication and Pydantic for data validation, it features token-based authentication with auto-refresh, pagination support for large datasets, flexible identifier resolution (supporting both IDs and reference numbers), and robust error handling with detailed API response parsing. The implementation supports all core Taiga operations from listing projects and members to creating and updating user stories with story points, due dates, and assignments, making it valuable for development teams who want to manage their agile workflows through conversational interfaces without switching between tools.
